company.name: Freesolo
company.shortDescription: Freesolo provides tools and infrastructure for companies to train, deploy, and monitor specialized product-native AI models.
company.description: Freesolo provides an artificial intelligence platform that helps companies build product-native language models tailored to specific tasks. The company offers tools for training small, specialized models using reinforcement learning, along with feature instrumentation and model evaluation. Its platform supports workflow analysis, automated feedback metrics, and production monitoring so models can be integrated into live product experiences. Freesolo focuses on encoding user-trajectory knowledge and post-training capabilities to transform generic models into application-specific systems. It serves engineering and product teams that need to move from experimental AI prototypes to stable production infrastructure. Freesolo also develops open-source components that let AI agents connect to search and corporate workflow systems.
